theorem primitive {C : Family G} (h : C.Makes) (a : Axis) (v : Fin (m+1) → C.book.Token)
    (hV : C.sufficient N v) {D} (hD : D≤N)
    (d : ℕ) (hr : d=(C.S.toDepth hD p).count.val)
    (c : Fin (m+1) → ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (x : Fin (m+1) → Site (C.side N p))
    (r : ℝ) (ht : 0<r) (he : ∀ i j, i≠j → (2*d:ℝ)+ 2*r < ((x j a-x i a).val:ℝ))
    (H : ∀ (i : Fin (m+1)) (w : C.book.Token), w=v i ∨ w=C.book.reflectedToken a (v i) →
      Interior ((center C.S p hD (x i)).chamber 0) (C.seen w (x i)) ∧
      (center C.S p hD (x i)).rootTest (C.beta N p) (C.seen w (x i)) ≤ c i)
    (u : Fin (m+1)) (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : (ℓ:ℝ) ≤ r) :
    ‖C.numeric N p v (update x u (x u+offset a (ℓ:Per (C.side N p))))-C.numeric N p v x‖ ≤ (∏ i, c i)/r*(ℓ:ℝ) := by

[L] proves the enclosing Lemma 14.17 by a different route: stepTotal -> primitive -> Slice organized -> TimeKernel.passage -> Holder.finite_lip, whose proof interpolates the exponent analytically (F x = total h b (W x) via leap), bounds |F| on a disc by `estimation`, and applies the Cauchy derivative bound `Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le` to get `<= cost X b p N / r * m`. No declaration or proof step in [L] writes the telescoping/commutator identity or the (1-T^l) splitting, so the display has no counterpart; it is not a typo, and although elementary algebra it is a mathematical step [M] asserts, not notation.
